description: This file is a Go source code file implementing a command-line tool for verifying import restrictions in Go packages, specifically for Kubernetes projects. It defines data structures, functions for loading restrictions, resolving package trees, and checking forbidden imports.

classes.name: Package
classes.description: Represents a Go package with directory, import path, and import dependencies.

classes.name: ImportRestriction
classes.description: Defines rules for allowed and restricted import paths within a package tree.

methods.name: ForbiddenImportsFor
methods.description: Returns all forbidden imports for a given package based on restrictions.

methods.name: isRestrictedDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory falls under import restrictions.

methods.name: forbiddenImportsFor
methods.description: Determines and returns a list of forbidden imports for a package.

methods.name: isForbidden
methods.description: Checks if a specific import path is forbidden based on restrictions.

methods.name: loadImportRestrictions
methods.description: Loads import restrictions from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: resolvePackageTree
methods.description: Resolves and retrieves all packages under a specified directory tree.

methods.name: decodePackages
methods.description: Decodes JSON output from 'go list -json' into Package objects.

methods.name: logForbiddenPackages
methods.description: Logs details of forbidden imports for a package.
